hero.title: What should we work on?
hero.descriptionNoScratch: Add a project to start your first thread.
hero.descriptionWithScratch: Add a project, or start without one.

row.noPermission: This connection lacks permission to change settings on {{targets}}.
row.reconnectToChange: Reconnect the selected environment to change this setting.
row.environmentWide: Environment-wide setting. Select an environment to change it.

responseStreaming.turnDescription: Text appears once the agent finishes its turn.
responseStreaming.paragraphDescription: Each paragraph or code block appears as soon as it is complete.

project-order.title: Project order
project-order.description: Order of projects in the sidebar project picker and command palette.

auto-resume-limited-threads.title: Resume after usage limits
auto-resume-limited-threads.description: Resume usage-limit stops at the reported reset time. Each thread can cancel its scheduled continuation.

snooze-limited-threads.title: Snooze until limits reset
snooze-limited-threads.description: Snooze usage-limit stops until reset. Pair with resume to continue on wake.

compact-idle-threads.title: Compact idle threads
compact-idle-threads.description: When to compact an idle Claude thread over 200,000 tokens: after you return, just before its prompt cache expires, or never. Each Claude provider can override this.

auto-settle-merged-threads.title: Auto-settle merged threads
auto-settle-merged-threads.description: Settle a thread when its pull request merges. Closed pull requests still settle automatically.

auto-settle-inactive-threads.title: Auto-settle inactive threads
auto-settle-inactive-threads.description: Sidebar threads with no activity for this long settle automatically.

days-before-auto-settle.title: Days of inactivity before auto-settle
days-before-auto-settle.description: Any new activity un-settles a thread automatically.

keep-threads-with-pr.title: Keep threads with a PR
keep-threads-with-pr.description: Inactivity does not settle threads with a pull request. Merge and close still do.

in-app-notifications.title: In-app notifications
in-app-notifications.description: Show a toast when another thread finishes, fails, or needs input or approval while this app has focus.

time-format.title: Time format
time-format.description: System default follows your browser or OS clock preference.

response-streaming.title: Response streaming
response-streaming.mixedDescription: The selected targets use different streaming modes.

hide-whitespace-changes.title: Hide whitespace changes
hide-whitespace-changes.description: Set whether the diff panel ignores whitespace-only edits by default.

default-diff-file-state.title: Default diff file state
default-diff-file-state.description: Start with files expanded or collapsed when opening diffs or a pull request's Code tab.

diff-layout.title: Diff layout
diff-layout.description: Show diffs stacked or side by side. The toggle in the diff toolbar changes this too.

proactive-panels.title: Proactive panels
proactive-panels.description: Open linked pull requests first. Otherwise, open Changes for edits to at least 3 files or 50 lines.

skills-in-slash-menu.title: Show skills in slash menu
skills-in-slash-menu.description: Also include skills in the / command menu. Skills always appear when you type $.

composer-rich-text.title: Rich text composer
composer-rich-text.description: Show formatted Markdown as you type.

composer-collapse.title: Collapse composer on scroll
composer-collapse.description: Rest the composer of an existing thread into a single line when you scroll the conversation. Focus the composer or start typing to expand it again.

send-shortcut.title: Send shortcut
send-shortcut.description: Choose when Enter sends a prompt or inserts a new line

follow-up-behavior.title: Follow-up behavior
follow-up-behavior.description: Queue follow-ups while the agent runs or steer the current run.
follow-up-behavior.hintMultiline: Press {{modifier}} + Enter for single-line prompts or {{modifier}} + Shift + Enter for multiline prompts to do the opposite for one message.
follow-up-behavior.hint: Press {{modifier}}{{shift}} + Enter to do the opposite for one message.

provider-update-checks.title: Provider update checks
provider-update-checks.description: Check installed provider CLIs for newer available versions and fetch model catalog updates. When off, new models may not appear.

continue-threads-after-server-update.title: Continue threads after restarts
continue-threads-after-server-update.description: Automatically resume interrupted threads after an update, crash, or machine restart on the selected environments.
continue-threads-after-server-update.unsupported: All selected connected environments must support restart continuation.

start-from-origin.title: Start from remote
start-from-origin.aria: Start new worktrees from remote by default
start-from-origin.description: Uses the latest commit of the base branch’s tracked remote branch, even if its name differs. Otherwise uses the same-named branch on origin. Uses your local branch if that remote branch is missing.

add-project-starts-in.title: Add project starts in
add-project-starts-in.description: Leave empty to use "~/" when the Add Project browser opens.

unpin-confirmation.title: Unpin confirmation
unpin-confirmation.description: Ask before unpinning a thread from the pinned section.

archive-confirmation.title: Archive confirmation
archive-confirmation.description: Require a second click on the inline archive action before a thread is archived.

delete-confirmation.title: Delete confirmation
delete-confirmation.description: Ask before deleting a thread and its chat history.

quit-confirmation.title: Quit shortcut
quit-confirmation.description: Hold mode also quits on two quick presses.

text-generation-model.title: Text generation model
text-generation-model.description: Used for thread titles and other generated text on connected devices with this provider. Source control can override it.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.description: How we handle your data, including the anonymous usage data T3 Code collects.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.descriptionEnvironment: Inspect processes, resource use, and logs on this environment.
diagnostics.descriptionAll: Inspect processes, resource use, and logs on one environment at a time.

open-source-licenses.title: Open source licenses
open-source-licenses.description: Notices for dependencies, assets, and optional tools used by T3 Code.

projectDefaults.modelProjectScope: Model for new threads in this project.
projectDefaults.modelAuto: Default model for new threads, selected automatically. Projects can override it.
projectDefaults.modelDescription: Default model for new threads. Projects can override it.
projectDefaults.modelUnavailable: This model is unavailable on {{environment}}. Select that environment to choose its model separately.
projectDefaults.workspaceProjectScope: Where new threads in this project start.
projectDefaults.workspaceDescription: Where new threads start. Projects and their t3.json can override it.
projectDefaults.permissionsProjectScope: Permissions for new threads in this project.
projectDefaults.permissionsDescription: Default permissions for new threads. Projects can override them.
projectDefaults.submodulesProjectScope: How new worktrees in this project populate git submodules.
projectDefaults.submodulesDescription: How new worktrees populate git submodules. Projects and their t3.json can override it.
projectDefaults.autoPullProjectScope: Keeps this project's default branch current when the checkout has no local changes or commits.
projectDefaults.autoPullDescription: Keeps the default branch current when the checkout has no local changes or commits. Projects can override it.
projectDefaults.agentCreditsDescription: Remove recognized agent credit lines from merge and squash messages on hosts that support it, keeping human co-authors. Includes auto-merge. Excludes merge queues, stack merges, and existing commits.
projectDefaults.mergeMethodProjectScope: Pull requests in this project start with this method.
projectDefaults.mergeMethodDescription: Pull requests start with this method. Last selected reuses whatever you chose most recently on this device.

threadTitle.description: Appended to the prompt for new and regenerated thread titles.
threadTitle.mixedPlaceholder: Mixed. Enter instructions to apply to all selected targets.
threadTitle.placeholder: Keep titles to a few words. Lead with the main subject.

cli.shadowed: Another t3 at {{path}} runs first in a new terminal. Remove it to use T3 Code's.
cli.notInstalled: Run T3 Code's CLI as `t3` from any terminal.
cli.installed: Installed at {{path}}. Open a new terminal to use it.
cli.notOnPath: Installed at {{path}}, which is not on your PATH yet. Add its folder to your PATH to run `t3`.

mobile.description: Connect to your server from your phone or tablet.

legacy.title: Legacy features
legacy.planModeDescription: Restore Build/Plan, /plan, /default, and Shift+Tab. Off uses build mode.
legacy.contextWindowDescription: Shows context window usage as a circular indicator in the composer.
legacy.sidebarDescription: Restore per-project thread trees instead of the default flat sidebar.

update.trackDescription: Use stable releases or nightly builds. Switch back anytime.
update.hostedTrackDescription: Switches the hosted app release channel.
update.autoUnavailable: Automatic updates are not available in this build.

textGeneration.connectPrompt: Connect an environment to choose its text generation model.

language.title: Language
language.description: Display language for the interface. "System" follows your operating system language.
